name: Sigil of Arathor
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Though they can barely be said to control Stromgarde, let alone the whole of Arathi Highlands, the human prince trots the remnants of his cavalry over the countryside. I can't understand why he does it, but who understands the way the humans think, hm?

Whatever his reasoning, more importantly, he has given one of the sigils to Lieutenant Valorcall, their cavalry leader. Locate him and bring his sigil back to me.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve the Sigil of Arathor and return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: Losing their cavalry leader will prove a large blow to the Stromgarde defenders. Better yet, it means that we are only one sigil from being able to have Trol'kalar for ourselves.
narrative.requestItemsText: Valorcall will not be easy to track down, adventurer. Mounted on horseback, he can cover ground quickly. Nonetheless, we must have his sigil.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 37 to 42, 18,920 XP in all.

quests.name: Trollbane
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Zengu.

quests.name: Sigil of Strom
quests.objectiveText: Get the Sigil of Strom for Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: The Broken Sigil
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the 5 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Thoradin
quests.objectiveText: Bring the restored Sigil of Thoradin to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Arathor
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Sigil of Arathor and return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Trollbane
quests.objectiveText: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Trol'kalar
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde.

quests.name: Trol'kalar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Trol'kalar to Zengu in Hammerfall.
